Commentary.Commentary: The pitch is getting slower and to overhaul 292 will take some serious batting from Ireland. They do have the resources but to deal with the Afghan bowlers is not going to be an easy task. Let's hope for an exciting chase. Do join us in a short while.

There was not enough teeth in the Irish bowling attack. They failed to bowl with consistency and kept on leaking runs. To add to their woes, their ground fielding was also not up to the mark. Apart from Kevin O'Brien, who finished with a 3-fer and Tim Murtagh who ended with decent figures, there isn't much to write about their bowling.

The Afghan middle order capitalized on the start and Rahmat Shah, in particular, batted with fluency in the middle overs. He never allowed the scoring rate to dip and kept the Irish bowlers on the edge. Hashmatullah Shahidi, Samiullah Shenwari and Mohammad Nabi also played handy cameos to take the Afghanistan total near the 300-run mark.

Powerful batting by Afghanistan to post a big total on the board. After electing to bat, their openers provided them a brilliant start. Once again Mohammad Shahzad was in his elements and hit extravagant shots, while his opening partner Noor Ali Zadran played second fiddle.
Yorker around off, Nabi digs it out towards mid-wicket for a single. AFGHANISTAN END THEIR INNINGS ON 292/7.
Length delivery on the sticks, Nabi mistimes his lofted shot, but the ball falls well short of the long on fielder who was running in. Two runs added to the total!
Angles in a length ball, Nabi drives it through covers and runs two.
FOUR! Fuller ball and way outside off, Nabi chases the ball and it takes the outside edge and sails towards third man fence for a boundary.
Length ball outside off, Nabi tries to clear covers but misses the ball.
Dawlat Zadran is in next.

OUT! Looks to bowl a yorker, but it ends up being a full toss. Naib gets under the ball and tries to slam it over mid-wicket, but doesn't get the elevation. Skipper Porterfield pouches it easily in the deep. Good start to the over for Ireland.
On a length around off, Naib creams it through mid off. One run added to the total!
Nabi lofts this fuller ball over mid off and runs one.
FOUR! Full toss, which dips a bit, on the sticks, Nabi pulls it to backward square leg for another boundary. He's getting some vital runs for his team here!
Swing and a miss! Length ball outside off, Nabi looks to go over covers but fails to put bat on ball.
FOUR! Attempts to bowl a slower ball, but the ball slips out of his hand and ends up being a full toss. Nabi has a swing at it and the ball goes over the point region for a boundary!
On a length outside off, Nabi backs away and drives it to wide long off for a couple.
Full and outside off, Nabi drives it down to long off for one run.
SIX! Tried to bowl the slower delivery around off, Nabi picked it up early, waited for the ball and slammed it high over the deep mid-wicket fence for a maximum. Enormous hit!
Fuller delivery around middle, Nabi slaps it to long on for a single.
Short of a length ball, which nips back in, Nabi swivels and pulls it towards deep the mid-wicket fielder, who slides to stop the ball. One run added to the total!
Naib knocks this fuller delivery down the ground for an easy single.
Wide! Bowls this delivery way outside off, Naib has no reason to play at it. The umpire calls it a wide.
Wide! Back of a length delivery, Naib looks to pull it away but gets beaten because of the pace, maybe.
Peter Chase comes back into the attack!
Full and on the stumps, eased down to long on for a single.
Sprays this down the leg side, tucked away towards the leg side. One run added to the total!
Good length delivery around off, Naib pushes it towards covers. Single taken!
On a length outside off, steered down towards the point region for a run.
Angles in a length ball, Nabi flicks it through mid-wicket and aims for a two. And ends up getting it easily.
Full and around off, pushed to covers for a single.
Tim Murtagh is back into the attack.
Length delivery outside off, cut to backward point for a single.
The batsman plays the square Cut. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Lands this full and outside off,  Nabi defends it towards the off side.
Gulbadin Naib is the new batsman.

OUT! It is a legal catch! Good catch by McBrine in the deep. Back of a length ball, which dipped a bit, Shenwari failed to get under the ball properly as he looks to slog. His miscued shot lobs towards long on, the fielder there runs in, slides and takes a good catch. Shenwari stands his ground and the umpire takes it upstairs. The lack of good camera angles has worked against the batsman as the third umpire has gone, maybe, with the soft call of the onfield umpire. Two wickets off three balls for Kevin O'Brien! Momentum changing over?
Samiullah Shenwari is caught at long on. The umpire is checking whether it's taken cleanly by Andy McBrine (sub) or not.
On a length, around off, Nabi drives it through covers for a single and gets off the mark.
Mohammad Nabi arrives.

OUT! Sharp catch! Length ball outside off, Shahidi shuffles far too across to chase and looks to slash. Ends up getting an outside edge and Niall, the keeper, takes a good catch to his left. Kevin O'Brien has ended the southpaw's handy cameo.
FOUR! Not in control but a boundary nonetheless. Tossed up ball on off, Shenwari slices his attempted drive and gets it away over point for a boundary. 18 runs off the over.
Yorker, around off, Shenwari digs it out back to the bowler.
SIX! And again. This one is even better, has gone all the way. Flighted ball on off, Shenwari decides to go against the turn and hammers it deep into the crowd at mid-wicket for a biggie.
SIX!  Full floated ball outside off, Shenwari gets down on one knee, throws his hands at it and powers it over extra cover for a maximum.
Fetches a full toss from outside leg and reverse pulls it to sweeper cover for a run.
Flatter full ball on off, drilled down the ground and the long off fielder did well near the fence to stop the racing ball. They pick up a single.
George Dockrell is back on to bowl his last over.
Aims for a yorker but bowls a full toss outside off, Shahidi advances down the track and lofts it over covers for a couple of runs. 19 runs off the last two overs!
Slower short delivery on middle, Shenwari swivels with his pull shot, doesn't quite time his shot and sends it through square leg for one.
Angles in a full length ball around off, from around the wicket to the left-hander, Shahidi whips it through mid-wicket for a run.
Serves a low full toss wide outside off, Shenwari chases it and forces it to sweeper cover for one.
Walks forward and works it through mid-wicket for a run.

FOUR! Shahidi welcomes O'Brien with a booming boundary. A full length delivery outside off, from around the wicket, there is plenty of width on offer and Hashmatullah drills it through covers for a boundary.
Kevin O'Brien is back into the attack.
Very full in length and on middle and leg, it's whipped through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Walks down to the pitch of the delivery and forces it towards long off for a run.
Shenwari has played it towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Third man comes up, fine leg drops back.
Length delivery outside off, Shahidi dabs it to point for a run.

FOUR! That's a handsome shot! Nothing much wrong with the delivery, just the sheer brilliance of the batsman. It's full and wide outside off, Shahidi shuffles across the stumps and muscles it over backward square leg for a boundary.
Full and angling away from the southpaw, Shahidi tries to power it through the cover region but fails to connect.
Tim Murtagh is back on.
Shortish on off, helped off the pads to short mid-wicket for one.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. They pick up a single.
Three wides! Chase slips one down the leg side, Shenwari fails to flick and the keeper also fumbles. They cross a couple of times.
Short in length around off, it's pulled down to long on for a run.
Slower back of a length delivery, way outside off, Shahidi has pulled it straight to the mid-wicket fielder.
Bowls a length delivery outside off, Shahidi clears his front leg and drives it straight to covers.
Fuller delivery and on the sticks, Shahidi knocks it back to the bowler.
Back of a length ball, around off, Shenwari makes room and cuts it straight to point.
Length delivery around off, Shenwari looks to flick but it goes off the outside edge of the bat to the bowler.
Length ball outside off, Shenwari drives it to covers.
Lands this on a length around middle, Shenwari blocks it from his crease.
Short delivery, Shahidi comes across and pulls it again. But this time it goes to the deep mid-wicket fielder. Single taken!
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Powerplay 3 has been signalled! Maximum five fielders are now allowed outside the ring.
FOUR! Short and comes back in, Shenwari camps back and pulls it firmly to deep square leg for a boundary.

Good length delivery on the sticks, slaps it back towards the non-striker's end and it hits the stumps and deflects towards mid on. Had the bowler got his hand to it, Shenwari would've been a goner. One run added to the total!
Back of a length delivery, outside off, Shahidi hops and looks to guide it to third man. But it goes straight to point. The batsman looks for a single but Shenwari has refused it.
Bowls a slower delivery on middle and leg, HS goes back and blocks it towards covers.
On a length, Shenwari nudges it towards mid-wicket and steals a quick single.
Length ball, which nips back in, Shenwari comes forward and defends it towards the off side.
Peter Chase comes back into the attack.
Good length delivery, outside off, steered down to third man. One run taken. 200-run mark comes up for Afghanistan.
Bowls a length ball outside off, Shahidi drives it to sweeper cover and runs one.
Angles in a length ball, around leg, tucked away through square leg. One run taken.
Bowls this a lot straighter and on the sticks, SS moves a bit and blocks it with the straight face of the bat.
On a length outside off, Shenwari defends it towards the off side.
Samiullah Shenwari walks in next.

OUT! Kevin strikes and he has removed the dangerman. Length ball, which comes back a touch, Shah clears his front leg and looks to clobber it over long on but doesn't time it very well. George Dockrell takes a regulation catch at that position. A sensible knock of 78 has come to an end.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. They pick up a single.
HS goes on his back foot and punches this floated delivery towards the off side. One run added to the total!
Loops this one outside off, cut away to sweeper cover for a single.
Shahidi drills this tossed up delivery through covers and runs one.
Tossed up around off, Shahidi pushes it towards the off side. Shah looks for a single but Shahidi says no.

FOUR! Short and outside off, asking to be punished and Shahidi obliges. Square cuts it with the turn past the diving short third man for a boundary. He would have wanted to play it more squarer but won't mind as the end result was good enough.
Length ball, fifth stump, Shahidi drives it through covers. Single taken!
FOUR! Smoked! Shahidi was struggling a bit but has broke the shackles. Comes down the track to this length ball and chips it over the mid off fielder for a boundary.
Lands this on a length outside off, Shahidi looks to cut but gets beaten on the inside edge.
Length ball, around off, flicked away to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Length ball, around middle and leg, flicked away towards short mid-wicket.
Back of a length ball, outside off, Shah drives it to mid off.
Kevin O'Brien is reintroduced into the attack.
Shahidi tucks this tossed up delivery towards mid-wicket.
Lower full toss outside off, jammed back to the bowler.
Flatter and quicker, around off, Shah makes room for himself and carves it through covers for a single.
Flatter and shorter, outside off, cut straight to the cover fielder.
Short and around off, pulled away through mid on for a single.
Bowls a low full toss and Shah drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Fullish on off, Shahidi drives it off his front foot to mid off. Excellent over by Murtagh, a wicket and two runs off it!
Hashmatullah Shahidi strolls out in the middle.
Time for drinks.

OUT! Edged and gone! Tim gets the breakthrough. Serves it on a fuller length just outside off, holding its line, Stanikzai pushes inside the line without any footwork and gets a faint outside edge behind to the keeper. Niall O'Brien collects it cleanly, they appeal and the finger goes up. Vital breakthrough for Ireland as this partnership was growing in confidence.
Sees the batsman charging in and digs in a short ball on middle and leg, Stanikzai still goes through his pull shot but mistimes it towards short fine leg.
Length ball on off, shaping in, punched through covers for a single.
Pitches it full and around off, Asghar quietly drops it in the gap at covers and pinches a single.
Length delivery outside off, Asghar tries to cut but misses.
Short and wide outside off, forced through covers for a single. 10 off the over!
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
In the air...safe! Dockrell shortens his length a bit around off, it stops  a bit onto the batsman, Stanikzai chips his shot in the air but it goes safely to mid off. A single.
Fires in a quicker one, as expected, a touch short and around leg, Shah goes back and punches it to long on. Rotates the strike.
SIX! Boom! What a shot! Floated ball landing around middle, Rahmat gets down on one knee, clears his front leg and sends it packing over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Arm ball around middle, Shah gets forward to defend but gets an inside edge on the back leg.
Full and angling in, defended from the crease to short mid-wicket.
Around off on a length, dabbed off the back foot to point.
Back of a length ball on middle, Shah drags his attempted pull shot and sends it off the inside half of the bat to deep mid-wicket. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fullish and angling in around off, Shah gets forward and pushes it back to the bowler.
Good length ball on off, punched down to long on for one.
Angles in a length ball on off, Shah stays back and pushes it with an angled bat through covers for a single.
Tim Murtagh is called back into the attack.
Drags his length short and lands it on middle, Shah gets back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
Flighted and fuller on off, it's pushed past the extra cover fielder for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Walks forward and pushes it past the diving bowler for a single at long on.
Loopy and full around leg, played with a straight bat to the leg side and the short mid-wicket made the stop.
FOUR! Full floated ball on middle, Shah goes down on one knee and slogs it powerfully to the deep mid-wicket fence. Fine connection.
On a length and around off, defended back off the back foot.

FOUR! Stanikzai takes the risk, gives the charge to the bowler and receives the shortish length ball with all his might. Swings his bat, doesn't connect well but still manages to clear mid on. The replays show that it fell just inside the rope and after getting the confirmation from upstairs, the onfield umpire signals a boundary. The third umpire took a lot of time to reach that decision.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Shortish around off, Rahmat swings his bat across the line and gets it away off the inner half of the bat. It rolls through backward square leg for a run.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Length ball angling down the leg side, Asghar tries to flick but misses. Good take by O'Brien behind the stumps. Not given a wide, maybe there was some thigh pad involved.
Uses his feet to this tossed up delivery and knocks it down to long on. One run added to the total!
Sprays this on the leg side, Shah tucks it away through backward square leg for a run.
Skipper Asghar Stanikzai is the new batsman.

OUT! And here it is! The bowling change works and Dockrell has broken the partnership. Tosses this one around off, Zadran goes down on one knee and mistimes his slog straight to McBrine(sub) at short mid-wicket. First wicket for Dockrell. Zadran must be ruing to give away a good start, he had an opportunity to score big but he has thrown it away.
George Dockrell is still in search of his first wicket.
Short and wide, Shah cuts it away towards covers for a single.
Tosses this one on leg, flicked towards mid on.
Bows it slower through the air and on leg, Shah knocks it back to the bowler.
George Dockrell is back for another spell.
Back of a length delivery, cut away to sweeper cover. One run added to the total!
Fuller delivery, on middle and leg, Shah goes back a bit and punches it to the cover fielder.
Marginally ahead of length, guides it to third man for an easy single.
Good length ball asking to be driven and Shah does, but only for a run towards long off.
On a length around off, Shah drives it to mid off.
Length ball, outside off, cuts it to the point fielder.
Peter Chase is back on.
Rahmat Shah eases this length delivery to long on and runs one.
4th ODI fifty for Rahmat Shah!
Length ball, which comes back in, flicked away to backward square leg for a couple. Fifty for Rahmat as well. Both batsmen bring up their half centuries in one over. Eventful one for Afghanistan!
Cuts this length ball towards the point region.
7th ODI fifty for Noor Ali Zadran!
Full delivery, around off, creams it through covers. Single taken. Brings up the milestone with that run! Well timed innings!
Length delivery, fifth stump line, cut towards sweeper cover and runs one.
On a length outside off, drives it through covers for a single.
Shortish delivery around leg, tucked to backward square leg.
Punches this tossed up delivery to long on. Single taken!
Short delivery which turns in, pulled away over mid-wicket for a single.
Uses his feet to this looped up delivery and flicks it to deep mid-wicket. One run taken.
Tossed up outside off, driven away through covers for a single.
Bowls it slower through the air around middle and leg, tucked away to mid-wicket for a single.
Drives this length ball to the cover fielder.
Length ball, which nips back in, looks to flick but it goes off the inner half of the bat towards mid-wicket, where Stirling makes a sharp stop.
Angles a full ball, around off, Shah stays in his crease to defend it.
Very full and on the pads, flicked away through mid-wicket for a run.
Good length delivery, fifth stump line, Zadran looks to chop it past point but mistimes it straight to the fielder.
Lands this on a length outside off, drilled through covers for a single.
Flatter and shorter in the line of the stumps, Rahmat goes back and punches it through mid on for one.
Another punch shot by Rahmat but once again he finds extra cover. Really frustrating for the batsman. Gary Wilson is doing the fielding job quite efficiently.
Long hop around off, Shah goes back and slaps it through the line. But he fails to beat the short extra cover fielder.
Full floated outside off, Rahmat sticks back and defends it to the off side.
Again it's a bit on the shorter side, Zadran gets back and eases it through mid-wicket for one.
Flattish and short on off, punched straight to mid on.
FOUR! Wrong line from the bowler. Hurls a full ball down the leg side, Rahmat picks it off his pads and neatly nudges it wide of short fine leg for a boundary.
Full and angling down, Noor Ali picks it off his pads and flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Misses out! Short and wide outside off, asking to be hit, Zadran cuts it through the line but finds point.
Hits the yorker mark around off, Noor Ali digs it out towards short cover.
Fires in a full ball on off, Zadran gets half forward and defends it towards short cover. Was looking to play towards mid-wicket.
Starts with a length ball around off, Rahmat sticks back and strokes it through covers for a run.
Stuart Thompson is introduced into the attack.
Quicker, flatter and on leg, it's worked through mid-wicket for one.
Flatter on middle, pushed off the back foot towards short mid-wicket. Stirling moved to his right to stop the ball.

SIX! Lovely shot! Loopy and around off, Rahmat dances down to the pitch of the delivery, takes a calculative risk as the mid off is inside the circle and chips it over his head. Fine timing and it sails all the way over the fence for a biggie.
Loopy and full on off, Shah lunges and defends it to the off side.
Full and on middle, turned off the pads to backward square leg for a run.
Advances down the track to a full ball and pushes it back to the bowler.
50-run stand comes up between Noor Ali Zadran and Rahmat Shah.
On a length and just outside off, Shah punches it off his back foot past the diving point fielder for a couple of runs.
Serves it full and outside off, Rahmat gets forward and plays it with an open face to backward point.
Fullish and just outside off, Zadran gets across and pushes it towards deepish mid on for a single.
Almost nicked it to the keeper! Full in length and outside off, slower in pace, Zadran tries to play a cheeky dab towards third man but fails to connect.
Short and wide outside off, cut through cover-point for a single.
Angles in a length ball on middle, defended off the back foot to wide mid on.

Quicker one, it's hit firmly back towards the right side of the bowler. A bit uppish but didn't carry to the bowler. However, Stirling did well to dive and parry it towards short mid-wicket. Another tidy over!
Flatter again, punched across the line and the short mid-wicket fielder came rushing in to make a diving stop.
Shortish on off, stroked off the back foot through covers for a single.
Turning back into the batsman, it's worked in the gap at mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and shorter on off, punched off the back foot to short mid-wicket.
Flighted full ball on off, eased down through mid on for a single.
Fuller delivery and on leg, drives it down the ground to long on. One run added to the total! Only two runs off the over.
Marginally ahead of length and outside off, tapped towards covers.
Good length delivery, outside off, driven to mid on.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Fuller delivery, which comes back in, Zadran shuffles across to flick and he does, but very late, towards wide mid on and runs one. He could've been LBW had he missed the ball.
On a length around off, Zadran pushes it to covers.
Cuts this tossed up delivery to sweeper cover and runs one.
Cuts this short delivery very well, albeit straight to the short third man fielder.
Floats this delivery on the sticks, knocked back to the bowler.
Loops this one outside off, Shah strides forward and drives it wide of mid off for a single.
Tossed up again, around off, Shah knocks it back to the bowler.
Tosses this one around off, Shah defends it towards the leg side.
Paul Stirling comes into the attack.
Drinks have been called.
On a length around off, Zadran taps it to point and looks for a run. Shah denies it.
Shah drills this length ball through covers and runs one.
Ireland's fielding needs urgent improvement. Length ball, outside off, Rahmat cuts it past the tumbling point fielder and runs two.

FOUR! Ireland's sloppiness in the field continues. Fuller delivery, Rahmat strides forward and drives it down the ground. The mid on fielder runs to his left, but fails to collect the ball as it goes through his legs. The ball beats the chasing mid off fielder and goes away for a boundary.
Length ball, around off, Shah goes back and punches it to mid off.
Rahmat drives this length ball to covers.
Zadran sweeps this floated delivery straight to the short fine leg fielder. Brilliant over for the visitors. First maiden of the match!
Tosses this one around leg, Zadran looks to flick but it hits his thigh pad and goes towards backward square leg.
Zadran moves ahead and defends this looped up delivery off his front foot.
Floats this one around off, Zadran leans and dead-bats it.
Zadran has clipped this floated delivery to mid-wicket.
Tossed up around middle, Zadran goes forward and blocks it.
On a length, on the pads, flicked to fine leg. One run added to the total! 100-run mark comes up for the hosts.
Rahmat punches this length ball through covers for an easy single.

SIX! That's out of the ground. Slightly short and that's enough for Rahmat Shah, who camps back and times his pull perfectly over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie. There was a fielder in deep, but all he could do was watch it sail over him.
Angles in a good length delivery, fifth stump line, Zadran pats it to point and sets off instantly.  The fielder there throws it at the non striker's end but it doesn't hit. Single taken!
Length delivery on the pads, worked away to deep square leg for a single.
Length ball, around off, Shah rocks back and dead-bats the ball from the crease.
Long hop and around off, Shah gets back to punch it towards long off for a run.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Loopy and on off, spinning away, Zadran does well to glide it past the short third man fielder. He chases it and pulls it back near the fence. They've managed to run three.
Again it's on the shorter side and Shah punches it past the bowler to long off for a run.
Nearly carries to the bowler! Flatter delivery, a touch short and around off, it's punched back a bit uppishly but doesn't carry to Dockrell.
Full and around leg, flicked off the pads to mid-wicket.
George Dockrell comes back into the attack.
Angles in on a good length around off, Zadran drops it with soft hands towards backward point and the fielder comes across to his left to stop the ball. Zadran wanted a run but is sent back.
Too full and on off, Zadran gets on the front foot and pushes it back to the bowler.
Once again it's short and wide outside off, Rahmat cuts it down to third man for a run.
Short in length and outside off, Shah punches it off his back foot to cover-point.

Lands it full again, just outside off, Shah tries to force it through the line but ends up playing it back to the bowler off the inside edge. O'Brien collects the ball and throws it at the stumps at the striker's end. Some aggression from the all-rounder!
Full in length and outside off, Rahmat gets forward and defends it to the off side.
Kevin O'Brien comes into the attack.

FOUR! Another poor delivery served by Mulder and this time he is not getting away with it. Short and wide outside off, Noor Ali camps back and places his square cut right through the gap for a boundary.
Drags his length short and outside off, Shah rocks back to cut and sends it to sweeper cover for a run.
Loopy and on off, Rahmat lunges to defend and does so off the inside half of the bat to mid-wicket.
Flatter and shorter on off, it's punched off the back foot past the short extra cover fielder to long off for a run.
Full flighted ball outside off, Shah advances down the track and drives it wide of the bowler to long off for a single.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, begging to be hit, Shah shows no mercy, latches onto it and slams it over point for a boundary. That was a really poor delivery!
Fullish and outside off, pushed down to mid on.
Slightly short and on off, Rahman defends it from the crease.
Serves one on the pads, it's worked through square leg for a run.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Tossed up and spinning away outside off, Zadran edges his attempted drive through backward point. Good stop in the deep and they take three runs.
Rahmat Shah is the new man in.

OUT! Shahzad is run out! This is a massive breakthrough for the Irish team. Loopy full ball on middle, Shahzad quietly turns it off his pads to mid-wicket and calls his partner through for a run. O'Brien moves to his right and sends in a flat throw towards the bowler's end. Mulder tries collecting the ball in front of the stumps and it seems he has broken it with his hand first. The third umpire is referred and the replays shows that it has hit the stumps and his hand at the same time, maybe. Though there is no conclusive evidence. One thing is sure that Shahzad is not inside the crease. RED light flashes and Shahzad heads back to the pavilion.
The umpire has gone upstairs for a run out against Mohammad Shahzad, who is in trouble!
Played to the point region by the batsman. No run.
Short and outside off, Shahzad tries to cut but misses.
SIX! Shahzad shows his partner how it's done. Goes back to a short ball and rockets his pull shot over mid-wicket for a biggie. Great connection.

Dropped first ball! Kevin O'Brien has made a complete mess. Flatter and shorter ball on middle, Zadran gets back to pull it across the line but gets a top edge. It balloons in the air, O'Brien at short mid-wicket circles around it but fails to judge it. Runs back a touch, tries taking the catch but it falls just wide. They take a single.
Jacob Mulder is into the attack.
Powerplay 2 time! Maximum 4 fielders are allowed outside the ring.

Poor this from Ireland. Length ball, Zadran stands in his crease and drives it down the ground. The mid on fielder runs ahead, probably having one eye at the batsman and not at the ball, and misfields. The ball rolls towards the long on fence and the batsmen run three.
Shortish delivery, MS pulls it away to deep deep square leg and runs one.
Back of a length ball, Zadran has pulled this towards short fine leg who makes a fine stop and saves some vital runs for his team. One run added to the total.
Leg bye! Marginally ahead of length, around leg, Shahzad moves across and looks to tickle but it goes off his thigh pad towards backward square leg. Leg bye taken.
Length ball, comes back in, Zadran works it around to deep square leg and runs one.
Short of a length delivery, swinging in, Zadran shuffles across and taps it to point. The fielder there hurls a throw at the striker's end and it hits. But the batsman is well in.
Angles in a length delivery, outside off, punched to covers.
Length ball, which comes back in sharply, Shahzad rocks back and clips it towards the leg side.
Full length ball, Zadran drives it to mid on and sets for a quick single.
Fuller delivery, which comes back in, Zadran knocks it back towards the bowler.
Length ball, around off, Zadran has defended it.

FOUR! Classy shot! Full delivery, on the sticks, Zadran lunges and drives it down the ground. The mid on fielder runs across to stop, gets his hand to it but parries it towards long off. The long off fielder chases it only to come second. The outfield is lightening quick.
Good length delivery, swinging in, Shahzad moves back and punches it towards covers.
Marginally ahead of length, on the sticks, whipped to mid-wicket.
Angles in a length ball, around off, Shahzad defends it from well within the crease.

FOUR! Sloppy fielding from Ireland. Bowls another short ball, down the leg side, MS moves across and just works it away with another pull. The short fine leg fielder doesn't bend to stop the ball, maybe he misjudged it. And the ball beats him and races away to the fence.
FOUR! Excellent shot. Bangs this short, Shahzad swivels across a touch, and pulls it past the diving mid-wicket fielder for a boundary. He's got a brilliant start.
On a length, nips back in, Shahzad shuffles across and nudges it to the mid-wicket fielder.
Zadran gets behind the line of this good length ball and blocks it towards covers.
Bowls a length delivery, outside off, Shahzad guides it to third man with outer half of the bat to third man and runs a single.
Length ball, outside off, Shahzad looks to make room for himself and cuts it towards the off side.
Full delivery, fourth stump line, MS offers a front foot defense.
Lands this on a length around off, Zadran flicks it to deep  mid-wicket. Single taken.
Bowls a length ball, around off, driven to mid on.
Looks to pull this shortish delivery but doesn't quite get the connection. The ball falls back on the pitch.
FOUR! Lucky runs for Afghanistan. Short of a length ball, which nips back in, Mohammad looks to pull but gets the under edge and goes past the keeper for another boundary.
Length ball, around off, Shahzad defends it towards the off side.
FOUR! Punished. Shahzad makes full use of the Free Hit. Short and outside off, MS makes room, clears the front leg and slaps the ball to the cover fence for a boundary.
Free Hit coming up...
No ball. Marginally ahead of length and outside off, Shahzad drives it straight to the mid on fielder. He will have to bowl that one again.
Angles in a full delivery on middle and leg, Zadran flicks it to mid-wicket and runs one.
Fuller all, around off, Zadran strides forward and drives it straight to the cover fielder.
Peter Chase is brought into the attack.
Good line, full and just around off, Shahzad defends it solidly off his back foot.
Full and angling in, defended back to the bowler who deflected it past the stumps to mid on.
Fuller and on off, Zadran plays it wit soft hands to mid-wicket where the fielder dives to stop the ball but cannot prevent the single.
A lovely straight drive by Zadran but this time the mid on fielder quickly moves to his left and gives no chance to the batsmen to cross.
Back of a length ball around off, Shahzad picks the line early and jabs it through mid-wicket for a run.
Fuller and straighter, knocked down the ground, just wide of the mid on fielder and they pinched a run.

FOUR! Boom! Flighted ball once again going down the leg side, Shahzad goes down on one knee and plays a firm sweep shot through backward square leg. There is a fielder in the deep but he had no chance of cutting it off. Went like a tracer bullet.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.

Direct hit would have been close! Flighted and around leg, Noor Ali flicks it towards square leg and crosses for a run. He was a bit lazy in completing the run and in a case of a direct hit, he would have been in trouble.
A touch shorter and on middle, Shahzad gets back and eases it through mid-wicket for a run.
Flatter ball on the pads, Shahzad turns it on the leg side but not in the gap.
Full in length and outside off, Shahzad gets forward with a big stride and pushes it with an angled bat to point.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Gully moves to short mid-wicket.
Angles a length ball around leg, straightening a bit, Zadran tries playing across the line but ends up pushing it back to the bowler.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full and angling in, Shahzad does well to use his wrists and he helps it through mid-wicket for a run.
Fuller and on middle,  defended back to the bowler.
Finds the gap on the leg side with his flick shot and gets a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. No run.
FOUR! Nicely done! Full floated delivery, around leg, Shahzad kneels and nails his sweep shot through backward square leg for a boundary.

Oohh... this one straightens a touch from the leg stump line, Shahzad tries working it on the leg side but closes the face of the bat early. Fails to make connection and it goes off his thigh pad towards first slip.
Full floated on off, Shahzad is on the front foot as he defends it back.
Gets forward and turns it off his pads to short mid-wicket.
Wide! Wrong line, fires a full ball down the leg side, the batsman leaves.
George Dockrell will bowl from the other end.
FOUR! Shot of the morning! An overpitched ball on off, Zadran gets forward with a straight bat and caresses it straight down the ground for a boundary.
Fullish and on off, Shahzad closes the face of the bat and softly works it towards backward square leg for one.
FOUR! First of the game! A touch short in length and around middle, Shahzad gets on top of the bounce and glances it off his hips through square leg for a boundary.
Too full and angling in around off, Zadran flicks it off his pads, wide of mid on this time and they cross for one.
Drops it on a fuller length outside off, Shahzad drives it off his front foot towards wide mid off and gets off the mark. Afghanistan are away!
Starts with a full length ball on off, Shahzad gets on the front foot and defends it to the off side.
The players are out in the middle and are taking their positions. Mohammad Shahzad and Noor Ali Zadran will open the batting. William Porterfield tosses the first new ball to Tim Murtagh.
Ireland XI - William Porterfield(c), Paul Stirling, Ed Joyce, Niall O'Brien(w), Gary Wilson, Kevin O'Brien, Stuart Thompson, George Dockrell, Jacob Mulder, Tim Murtagh, Peter Chase.
Afghanistan XI - Noor Ali Zadran, Mohammad Shahzad, Rahmat Shah, Hashmatullah Shahidi, Asghar Stanikzai, Mohammad Nabi, Rashid Khan, Gulbadin Naib, Dawlat Zadran, Amir Hamza, Samiullah Shenwari.

Ireland skipper, William Porterfield says that the morning start will make it little tacky. Reckons that the deck will get flat. Opines that there were a few positives with the bat (in T20I series). Admits that there is room for improvement in death bowling.

Afghanistan skipper, Asghar Stanikzai says that they will bat first. Opines that the wicket is looking good and that is the reason they want to bat first. Thinks that it might help the spinners later on. Admits that the morale is really high after winning the T20Is.
TOSS - Afghanistan win the toss and elect to bat first.

PITCH REPORT - There is good covering of grass on the surface and as the game progresses the ball will spin. The seamers too will get help early on and the team that wins the toss should look to bowl first.

Hello and welcome to the coverage of the 1st ODI between Afghanistan and Ireland. The hosts had an outstanding T20I series as they whitewashed Ireland 3-0. With some new faces to join the visitors for the ODI series, there could be a change in their approach and the outcome. The visitors enter the contest as underdogs, merely because of Afghanistan's rapid rise and potential. Can the odds change or will the hosts continue their brilliant run? Stay tuned for the toss....
